SQL query execution endpoints

Provides direct SQL access to the database with safety measures

Module Contents

database.routers.query.router
database.routers.query.ALLOWED_TABLES
async database.routers.query.execute_query(request: database.schemas.SQLQueryRequest, session: database.dependencies.SessionDep) → database.schemas.SQLQueryResponse[source]

Execute a SQL query against the database

Safety measures: - Read-only queries only (SELECT) - Limited result size - Query timeout

async database.routers.query.list_tables(session: database.dependencies.SessionDep, include_samples: bool = False) → List[database.schemas.TableInfo][source]

List all available tables with metadata

Returns information about each table including: - Table name - Record count - Column names - Indexes - Sample data (optional)

async database.routers.query.get_table_schema(table_name: str, session: database.dependencies.SessionDep) → Dict[str, Any][source]

Get detailed schema information for a specific table

Returns: - Column definitions with types - Primary keys - Foreign keys - Indexes - Constraints

async database.routers.query.validate_query(request: database.schemas.SQLQueryRequest) → Dict[str, Any][source]

Validate a SQL query without executing it

Checks for: - Syntax errors - Forbidden operations - Table existence
